title: VoiceProfile
description: Author voice profile. Derived from Bunko BUNKO-VOICE-PROFILE-SCHEMA-v0.1. All fields are measurable on output prose. Profiles are YAML on disk; this schema validates them after YAML load. See schemas/profiles section of IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 4 T4.1.

profile_version.description: Semantic version (e.g. '1.0.0'). Bumped on meaningful change.

series_id.description: Series this profile is scoped to. Null for universal profiles.

style_markers.description: Measurable voice axes. Maps to Bunko schema §3–11. Stub — enumerate all sub-fields during Phase 4 T4.1 implementation.

sentence_length_histogram.description: Target % of sentences per word-count bucket (1-5, 6-10, 11-20, 21-35, 36-50, 51+). Stub — expand during Phase 4.

modality_ratios.description: Target fraction of sensory references per modality (sight, sound, touch, smell, taste, proprioception).

no_fly_words.description: Hard-banned words or multi-word phrases. Any occurrence = REJECT. See Bunko schema §4.

no_fly_patterns.description: Regex-based forbidden constructions. See Bunko schema §12.

tonal_mode.description: e.g. warm_commercial, literary_precise, funny_and_light. Stub — enumerate during Phase 4.

pacing_targets.description: Per-scene-type pacing targets. Mirrors Bunko schema §8. Keys are scene_type values.

exemplar_pool.description: Reference to computed voice-axis measurements derived from corpus (no prose retained). Stub — expand during Phase 6 Voice Extraction Pipeline.

enforcement.description: Conformance thresholds and dimension weights. Mirrors Bunko schema §13. Stub — expand during Phase 4.

calibration_history.description: Ordered log of recalibration rounds. Append-only. Mirrors Bunko schema §14.
